body:
Adds `research/compressed-outer`: exact stationary noise floor and stability limit for local SGD with unbiased sparsified or dither-quantised pseudo-gradient reports. Random participation is the special case ω = 1/p−1. At fixed bandwidth, sparsification favours few full reports, while quantisation has an interior optimum near 1.3 bits per coordinate. Includes 10 unit tests, an experiments script with results, a whitepaper, and the README and site entries. `python site/build.py` prints ok.
